Doctor of Philosophy - Business and Mana.curriculum: This is a genuine research degree with no coursework curriculum. Candidates complete an original supervised thesis under the guidance of at least two supervisors, following an approved research proposal in a business or management discipline (accounting, economics, finance, management, marketing or a related field). Progress is formally reviewed at set milestones (typically at 6, 18 and 34 months full-time equivalent) by the Graduate Research School, and the degree is completed through submission and external examination of the thesis rather than through enrolment in taught units.
Doctor of Philosophy - Business and Mana.admission_requirements: Applicants must demonstrate a capacity to carry out independent research and adequate training to pursue the proposed research topic. This is normally satisfied by a Master's degree, or a Bachelor's degree with First or Upper Second Class Honours, or a Bachelor's degree plus a Graduate Diploma (or a Master's by coursework) with a course-weighted average of at least 70%. In exceptional circumstances, applicants with a Bachelor's degree and substantial relevant peer-reviewed publications or research experience may also be considered. A supervisor and an approved research proposal must be secured before admission; full detail is in Section 3.2.1 of Curtin's HDR admission policy.
Doctor of Philosophy - Business and Mana.english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall band score of 6.5, with no individual band below 6.0 (or an equivalent approved English test), per Curtin's standard Higher Degree by Research English requirement.

Doctor of Philosophy - Medicine.curriculum: This is a genuine research degree with no coursework curriculum. Candidates complete an original supervised research project culminating in a thesis. Admission requires satisfying one of a specific set of eligibility criteria set out in Curtin's Statute No. 12 enrolment rules: a Master's degree by thesis; a Bachelor's degree with First or Upper Second Class Honours; a Bachelor's degree plus a Graduate Diploma or coursework Master's with a course-weighted average of at least 70% and demonstrated research capacity; in exceptional circumstances, a Bachelor's degree with substantial relevant peer-reviewed publications, conference papers or research experience; an equivalent qualification from another recognised institution; or at least 6 months' full-time-equivalent enrolment in a research Master's with exceptional early-stage progress that can be converted to a Doctorate with Faculty Graduate Studies Committee approval. All applicants are interviewed prior to admission. The skills, experience and publications gained are described by Curtin as useful preparation for specialist clinical training, academic roles, or posts involving a research component.
Doctor of Philosophy - Medicine.admission_requirements: Admission requires satisfying one of the criteria above (Master's by thesis; Bachelor's with First/Upper Second Class Honours; Bachelor's plus Graduate Diploma or coursework Master's with 70%+ average and demonstrated research capacity; substantial publications/research experience in exceptional cases; an equivalent overseas qualification; or documented early-stage research progress converted from a Master's). A supervisor and an approved research proposal must be secured before admission, and all applicants are interviewed prior to admission.
Doctor of Philosophy - Medicine.english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall band score of 6.5, with no individual band below 6.0 (or an equivalent approved English test), per Curtin's standard Higher Degree by Research English requirement.

Master of Philosophy (Accounting).curriculum: This is a genuine research degree with no coursework curriculum. Candidates complete an original supervised research thesis in an accounting discipline, with progress formally reviewed at set milestones by the Graduate Research School.
Master of Philosophy (Accounting).admission_requirements: Applicants for a Master by Research must meet Curtin's academic and English language entry standards. Applicants admitted into an end-on Honours degree at Curtin but not yet awarded their Honours are eligible for entry, provided they meet the required grade threshold. A supervisor and an approved research proposal must be secured before admission.
Master of Philosophy (Accounting).english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall band score of 6.5, with no individual band below 6.0 (or an equivalent approved English test), per Curtin's standard Higher Degree by Research English requirement.

Master of Research (Agriculture).curriculum: This is a genuine research degree with no coursework curriculum. It develops a strong critical and problem-solving approach to professional practice in the natural and physical sciences, forming a basis for doctoral study through an original supervised research thesis in an agriculture-related discipline.
Master of Research (Agriculture).admission_requirements: Applicants must have qualified for a Bachelor Honours degree (First or Second Class) or an equivalent qualification from a recognised tertiary institution. Applicants who have qualified for a Bachelor Honours (First or Second Class) are eligible to enter the Master of Research directly; on entry they do not take out their Honours qualification but elect to continue into the Master's degree, with Honours remaining available as an exit award. A supervisor and an approved research proposal must be secured before admission.
Master of Research (Agriculture).english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall band score of 6.5, with no individual band below 6.0 (or an equivalent approved English test), per Curtin's standard Higher Degree by Research English requirement.

Graduate Certificate in Clinical Physiot.curriculum: This Graduate Certificate is an exit-only award for the Master of Clinical Physiotherapy, recognising students who choose not to continue in the full Master's course. It comprises 100 credits (4 units) selected from the Master's shared first-year unit pool, which includes Lifespan Health, Foundations of Continence and Pelvic Health, Advanced Anatomy and Pathology, Physiotherapy Project Proposal, Musculoskeletal Science Advanced Competencies 1 and 2, Sports Rehabilitation Science, Continence and Pelvic Health Clinics 1, Advanced Sports Physiotherapy Clinics 1, and Advanced Musculoskeletal Clinical Competencies 1, drawn from whichever specialisation stream (continence and pelvic health, musculoskeletal, or sports and exercise physiotherapy) the student was enrolled in.
Graduate Certificate in Clinical Physiot.admission_requirements: This Graduate Certificate is not a direct-entry award; it is earned only by exiting early from the Master of Clinical Physiotherapy. Entry to the Master requires a Bachelor's degree in physiotherapy (or equivalent) plus at least two years of relevant clinical experience, current registration with the Physiotherapy Board of Australia (or eligibility for limited registration for postgraduate training in Australia), and evidence of completion of an approved first aid (CPR) course. Entry to the Master is competitive with limited places, and supplementary information must be submitted with the application.
Graduate Certificate in Clinical Physiot.english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall band score of 7.0, with no individual band (Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking) below 7.0, matching the entry tier for the parent Master of Clinical Physiotherapy (one of Curtin's health-professional courses with higher English language requirements).

Graduate Certificate in Corporate Innova.description: The Graduate Certificate in Corporate Innovation at Curtin University is an exit-only award of the Master of Innovation and Entrepreneurship, equipping business professionals with the knowledge to introduce innovation and entrepreneurship (or intrapreneurship) into a corporate environment. It covers marketing for managers, cultural awareness and ethics, and the creative and innovation skills needed to transform and renew an organisation. Graduates typically move into knowledge-manager or innovation-manager roles in private and government organisations. Indicative international tuition is around 30,800 Australian dollars per year. Courses at Curtin are primarily taught on campus at the Bentley Perth campus, with some units also available online.
Graduate Certificate in Corporate Innova.curriculum: This is a fixed, fully core, one-semester full-time (or equivalent part-time) program of 4 units, all compulsory: Culture and Ethics in Global Business, Organisational Change and Transformation, International Marketing for Managers, and Creativity and Innovation. It is not available for direct entry; it is reached only by exiting early from, or otherwise progressing through units of, the Master of Innovation and Entrepreneurship.
Graduate Certificate in Corporate Innova.admission_requirements: This Graduate Certificate is an exit-only award and is not open for direct entry. It is earned by completing its 4 core units while enrolled in the Master of Innovation and Entrepreneurship.
Graduate Certificate in Corporate Innova.english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall band score of 6.5, with no individual band below 6.0, Curtin's standard postgraduate coursework English requirement (this course is not on Curtin's list of courses with higher English language requirements).

Graduate Certificate in Diabetes Studies.description: The Graduate Certificate in Diabetes Studies at Curtin University is a fully online postgraduate qualification for registered nurses, midwives and paramedics who want to develop specialist knowledge in diabetes care and education. Students study physical, biological, psychological and psychosocial aspects of diabetes through inter-professional, evidence-based coursework and a clinical placement in a diabetes-related health service. Graduates typically move into diabetes educator and diabetes-care roles. Indicative international tuition is around 34,900 Australian dollars per year. This course is delivered part-time online only and is not available to international students studying in Australia on a student visa; international applicants complete it externally from their home country.
Graduate Certificate in Diabetes Studies.curriculum: A 100-credit (4-unit), fully online program. Semester 1 core units: Living with Diabetes and Understanding Diabetes. Semester 2: the core unit Chronic Condition Self-Management, plus one elective chosen from Clinical Workforce Development, Leadership for the Clinical Context, Clinical Safety and Quality, or Clinical Management.
Graduate Certificate in Diabetes Studies.admission_requirements: Applicants for a Graduate Certificate must hold a Bachelor's degree or equivalent credit for recognised learning, and generally must already be a registered nurse, midwife or paramedic given the course's clinical-placement component and inter-professional healthcare focus, in addition to meeting Curtin's general academic and English language entry standards.
Graduate Certificate in Diabetes Studies.english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall band score of 6.5, with no individual band below 6.0, Curtin's standard postgraduate coursework English requirement.

Graduate Certificate in Food Science and.curriculum: This course is an exit award of the Graduate Diploma in Food Science and Technology and the Master of Science (Food Science and Technology), recognised by the Australian Institute of Food Science and Technology. It provides industry-relevant knowledge in food safety and preservation, chemistry, microbiology and food processing, with the course coordinator helping select units to suit each student's professional needs, drawn from the shared first-year units of the parent Master's degree.
Graduate Certificate in Food Science and.admission_requirements: Applicants require a Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in a science-related field, or relevant industry experience in food production, quality or safety, plus Curtin's general academic entry standards. It can be undertaken as a standalone qualification or as a pathway into the Graduate Diploma and Master's.
Graduate Certificate in Food Science and.english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall band score of 6.0, with no individual band (Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking) below 6.0.

Graduate Certificate in Information Syst.curriculum: A one-semester full-time (or equivalent part-time) program of 4 units within the Master of Information Systems and Technology, covering systems analysis and design, introduction to programming, database systems, and technical infrastructure. It is designed for business-management professionals with no prior computing background and can be completed as a standalone qualification or as a pathway into the Master's.
Graduate Certificate in Information Syst.admission_requirements: A Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in a field other than information systems/technology, or at least 5 years of relevant work experience, plus Curtin's general academic entry standards.
Graduate Certificate in Information Syst.english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall band score of 6.5, with no individual band below 6.0.

Graduate Diploma in Geoscience.description: The Graduate Diploma in Geoscience at Curtin University is an intermediate exit-only award of the two-year Master of Geoscience, for students who have completed the first year of that degree but choose not to continue to the full Master's. The Master of Geoscience itself provides advanced technical and professional training for graduates upgrading their geology or geophysics qualifications, or moving into a new branch of geoscience, with a choice of major in Exploration and Mining Geology or Geophysics. Graduates work as exploration geologists and geoscientists across the resources sector. Indicative international tuition is around 50,100 Australian dollars per year. Courses at Curtin are primarily taught on campus at the Bentley Perth campus.
Graduate Diploma in Geoscience.curriculum: A one-year, first-year-of-Master's curriculum. Semester 1 core units include STEM Research Methodologies and Applied Remote Sensing, plus a 50-credit elective choice from units including Mining Geology and Resource Estimation, Applied Geochemistry, Mineral Deposits, Hydrogeology and Engineering Geology, and Environmental Geoscience (the actual unit choices vary by the student's chosen Master of Geoscience major, Exploration and Mining Geology or Geophysics).
Graduate Diploma in Geoscience.admission_requirements: This is an intermediate exit-only award and is not open for direct entry; it is earned by completing the first year of the Master of Geoscience. Entry to the Master of Geoscience itself generally requires a Bachelor's degree in geology, geophysics or a related science.
Graduate Diploma in Geoscience.english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall band score of 6.5, with no individual band below 6.0, Curtin's standard postgraduate coursework English requirement.

Graduate Diploma in Health Studies.description: The Graduate Diploma in Health Studies at Curtin University is an intermediate exit award for students who begin, but do not complete, any of several health professional Master's degrees: the Graduate Entry Master of Speech Pathology, Master of Occupational Therapy, Master of Pharmacy, Master of Nursing Practice, Master of Midwifery, Doctor of Physiotherapy, Master of Physiotherapy or Master of Social Work (Qualifying). It is not a standalone, direct-entry qualification, and its exact curriculum and workload depend entirely on which parent degree the student was enrolled in. Indicative international tuition is around 31,000 Australian dollars per year. Courses at Curtin are primarily taught on campus at the Bentley Perth campus.
Graduate Diploma in Health Studies.curriculum: This is an intermediate exit award with no fixed curriculum of its own; it comprises whichever core units the student had completed within their specific parent degree (Speech Pathology, Occupational Therapy, Pharmacy, Nursing Practice, Midwifery, or Physiotherapy) at the point they chose to exit early.
Graduate Diploma in Health Studies.admission_requirements: This Graduate Diploma is not open for direct entry; it is reached only by exiting early from one of its named parent Master's degrees, each of which carries its own separate admission requirements (generally a relevant Bachelor's degree plus, for several of the named degrees, professional registration or clinical experience in the discipline).
Graduate Diploma in Health Studies.english_requirements: The English requirement follows whichever parent degree the student was enrolled in. Most of the named parent degrees (Master of Nursing Practice, Master of Midwifery, Doctor of Physiotherapy, Master of Physiotherapy, Master of Social Work) carry Curtin's higher health-professional English tier of IELTS Academic overall 7.0 with no band below 7.0; the university's own standard postgraduate tier of overall 6.5 with no band below 6.0 is the baseline where a higher tier does not apply.

Graduate Diploma in Human Nutrition.description: The Graduate Diploma in Human Nutrition at Curtin University is a one-year, full-time postgraduate qualification that applies knowledge in key areas of nutrition and integrates research principles into practice. Students learn to appraise data assessing the nutritional health status of individuals, groups and populations, and to collaborate with clients and population groups to improve nutritional status. Graduates typically work in public health nutrition, dietetics-adjacent, and food and nutrition program roles. Indicative international tuition is around 37,400 Australian dollars per year. Courses at Curtin are primarily taught on campus at the Bentley Perth campus.
Graduate Diploma in Human Nutrition.curriculum: A 200-credit (8-unit), one-year program. Semester 1 core units: Dietetic and Food Service Management, Dietetic Counselling Theory and Practice, Pathophysiology for Dietetics, and Evidence Informed Public Health Practice. Semester 2 core units: Advanced Public Health Nutrition Practice and Dietetic Professional Studies, plus a 50-credit elective choice that includes Quantitative Methods, Health System Planning, and Organisational units.
Graduate Diploma in Human Nutrition.admission_requirements: Applicants require a Bachelor's degree in nutrition, food science, health science or a related discipline (or equivalent credit for recognised learning), plus Curtin's general academic entry standards.
Graduate Diploma in Human Nutrition.english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall band score of 6.5, with no individual band below 6.0, Curtin's standard postgraduate coursework English requirement.

Graduate Diploma in Occupational Health.curriculum: An 8-core-unit, fully online program building on the Graduate Certificate in Occupational Health and Safety and providing a pathway into the Master of Occupational Health and Safety. It covers workplace health and safety management, regulatory compliance, and risk management, and carries national accreditation from the Australian OHS Education Accreditation Board and international accreditation from the UK's Institution of Occupational Safety and Health (IOSH).
Graduate Diploma in Occupational Health.admission_requirements: A Bachelor's degree, preferably in a health, science or management-related field, or a Graduate Certificate in Occupational Health and Safety from a recognised tertiary institution. International students can only undertake this course externally (online) from their country of origin; it is not available to international students studying on a visa in Australia.
Graduate Diploma in Occupational Health.english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall band score of 6.5, with no individual band (Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking) below 6.0.

Master of Occupational Health and Safety.curriculum: A three-semester full-time (or equivalent part-time), fully online program. In the final semester students complete an original research project supervised by academic staff. It is possible to exit early with a Graduate Certificate or Graduate Diploma in Occupational Health and Safety once the corresponding units are completed. The course carries international accreditation from the UK's Institution of Occupational Safety and Health (IOSH); graduates are eligible to apply for IOSH membership and for certification with the Safety Institute of Australia.
Master of Occupational Health and Safety.admission_requirements: A Bachelor's degree with a health, science, engineering or management-related background, or a Graduate Diploma in Occupational Health and Safety. This course is not available to international students studying in Australia on a student visa; international students can only take it externally (online) in their country of origin.
Master of Occupational Health and Safety.english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall band score of 6.5, with no individual band (Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking) below 6.0.
